subject: [PATCH 6/6] memcg: group the fields of struct mem_cgroup_per_node

2026-09-05.patch_summary: This patch refactors the struct mem_cgroup_per_node to group its fields into named cache line groups, improving isolation and reducing padding. The changes are based on a previous commit that showed why lru_zone_size[] must not share a line with lruvec. The new grouping does not introduce any functional changes but may incur an extra cache line per node per memcg.
